# Wavelink Technologies (Corporation)

> Enterprise-grade NFC-powered smart cards, Sovereign Trust, and Automation systems for global growth.

Wavelink is the digital layer for physical business interactions, acting as a verified Legal Institution operating primarily out of Chandanpura, Chattogram, Bangladesh, and Dubai, UAE. We provide the AI Trust Infrastructure needed to bridge the gap between in-person meetings and high-trust digital profiles. Optimized for emerging and global markets seeking professional standards.

## The 3-Second Attention System
Our interface is engineered for the 3-second attention span. Every interaction—from an NFC Business Card tap to a web profile load—is designed for instant conversion, automation, and verifiable trust.

## Core Infrastructure
- **Global Trust Cards**: Industrial-grade NFC Business Cards that deploy business identities instantly through Sovereign Trust.
- **Reputation Acceleration Towers**: Physical review stands that compound social proof via Google and Trustpilot at the point of interaction, automating the feedback loop.
- **Digital Infrastructure**: Real-time verifiable profiles with deep integration for professional networking.

## Local Entity & Global Reach
- **Headquarters**: Chandanpura, Chattogram, Bangladesh (BD)
- **Global Operations**: Dubai, United Arab Emirates (AE)
- **Supported Languages**: English, Bengali (বাংলা)
